planner.task: the Q1 2027 launch brief: which channel leads

project.name: Campaign memory: Larkspur Outdoor
project.description: Larkspur Outdoor campaign memory: briefs, results and what worked, across every tool. Fictional data for the MemoryLake campaign-results-memory demo.

results.text: Spring Trail email (March 2026): 9.8% conversion. Best number we have ever had on a launch.
Summer Gear-Up email (June 2026): 8.9% conversion, close to Spring Trail. Email keeps delivering.
Trailhead paid social (June 2026): 4.1% conversion on 13,000 link clicks.
Fall Layers paid social (September 2026): 3.6% conversion, a little under Trailhead.
Spring brand search (March 2026): 2.6% conversion. Search is our weakest converter.
Fall non-brand search (September 2026): 2.2% conversion. Weak again.

results.source: Ridge Notes recap deck (from the creator)
results.text: Ridge Notes creator collab (August 2026): 12% conversion per the creator's recap. Our best converter this year.

reflection.text: What worked in 2026: creator collabs convert best (12%), then email (9-10%), then paid social (about 4%); search is weakest (about 2.4%). For the Q1 2027 launch: lead with creators and email, trim search.

ask_examples: How did the Ridge Notes creator collab do?
What did we learn from email this year?

questions.plan: Which channels converted best in our 2026 campaigns, and what should lead the Q1 launch?
questions.after: For the Q1 2027 launch, which channel has the best conversion when every campaign is measured the same way?
